## 33c1de6c4310

**Reproduced override-contract defect.** Generator SHA-256
`ae79d56b2040bd6d605ad7664cf155c2d1765fb01086c6fa70379d1cab49709e`
matched the assignment. The generator accepts an unknown keyword override
(`__override_contract_unknown_axis__`) and returns a grid instead of rejecting
the typo. The shared override checker ran 49,950 draws over 555 cases and failed
with exactly this one root cause. Evidence:
`checks/audit-stage-33/checks/33c1de6c4310_after_override.log` and
`checks/audit-stage-33/checks/33c1de6c4310_after_override_results.json`.

The problem is contract safety rather than the transformation itself: all 3
canonical pairs matched the Python mirror, and 90 generated samples across the
three bands passed `self_check`. A direct exact-axis probe also showed requested
`grid_h=11`, `panel_w=9`, `mask_components=3`, and `src_colors=5` were realized;
its observation hook omits `grid_h` and `texture`, which is worth clarifying but
was not the shared check's blocking finding. Evidence:
`checks/audit/audit_probe.json`. I made no changes to this audit-only target.
